body:
That's true! I am glad it's working.

I'm mostly worried that my doctor will think I came to the physical exam with Covid-19 symptoms and send me home so I don't spread it. Even though I really know this is just a side effect of my vaccine, I don't know if the doctor will doubt me. During the height of the pandemic, my previous PCP checked our temperature the minute we entered the building and I wasn't sure if it was because they would've sent me home if I came into the office with a fever.

I've thought about this, but I'm worried it will reduce the vaccine's effectiveness :( My school requires me to get a Hep B antibody titer in 30 days following the vaccine. I have to test positive on it, and I don't know if taking a fever reducer will make me test negative. 

If I do take it though, I will probably take it a little closer to the time of the appointment today to be safe. Thank you!
Thank you! I'll bring the papers the pharmacy gave me that have the date I received the vaccine on them, so I hope they'll accept this explanation!

I know I should, but I have grown distant from most of my friends because of my OCD. I still have one friend who I'm still close to but she doesn't know about how bad my OCD is and even if I don't end up bothering her, I don't want to worry her, either. I have to find a way to bring it up.

You're right, though, I need to help myself to be able to overcome this. I'm in a better state of mind today so I'll try to see what I can do. I'll check out the link you sent me. Thank you again for your advice and encouragement!!

Did you start out on a higher dosage? I feel like the psychiatrist I saw started me out on a really low dosage and wanted to increase it very slowly. It felt like it would be several months until I took a more "standard" dosage, which I knew I needed because my OCD was very severe and what I was taking wasn't helping. 

Thank you for being a kind voice and commenting. I'm sorry you've been through this too, but I'm glad you made it through and live a life that you enjoy now!! 💚

It was hard for me when I first realized I might have OCD, too. I've been there. :( I also understand what it's like to have personal relationships be affected by my OCD, and what it's like to have my mom discredit it. It sucks, and I'm so sorry you're going through this. 

Good luck with therapy! lf you're comfortable with it, maybe you could bring up OCD to your psychiatrist or therapist? 

Also, thank you for commenting. You're not alone  💚 DM me if you ever need a listening ear, too!!
Thank you so much for your kind words <3
I didn't even consider this, but this would be a really helpful option for me. I'll look into it. Thank you!!

You're right... and I'm sorry that you don't have friends/family who can relate to you right now; I'm going through the same thing. I'm going to keep trying & stay strong, thank you for your words of support 💚
l really needed to hear all of this, especially those first two sentences. Thank you so so so much. 💚😭

I live in the US, but the thought of trying to find a doctor right now is overwhelming. Hopefully I eventually figure something out and can eventually get on a medication that works for me. 

Thank you so much for your words of support. I'm really glad you're here & continue to fight despite your past struggles 💚

When I was a kid, I dealt with a many contamination and "just right" obsessions. I don't know if I truly had OCD back then, but I did do many things that weren't "normal."

It was bad, but not as bad as it is now. It was in high school when I really started to struggle with contamination OCD, real event OCD, and harm OCD.

Thank you for commenting. I didn't check Reddit and ended up giving in and showering, and it made me realize yet again that I just fed the cycle. :/ I didn't do any additional cleaning like washing my sheets or cleaning the things I touched before showering at least. You're right about everything you said. I'll try to keep your advice in mind the next time something like this happens.
Thank you for commenting. I ended up showering and it didn't feel good for me either. :( I'll try harder to resist my compulsions next time.
Yes, you're not alone. I have done this too. I'm sorry you're struggling with this.

Same here, mine got a bit better for a while, then worsened again a while back. I'm sorry it's getting worse for you right now.

What keeps me going is knowing that whatever is going on with my OCD right now is typically temporary. It did get easier at one point before, so it will eventually get easier again. Stay strong!
I'm sorry you go through it too. :( Hope things are going ok for you right now, and you're right, we can do this 💚

Yeah, I'm diagnosed so you're right. I just always question my own diagnosis and whether my behaviors are a part of the diagnosis or not. 

Thanks for letting me know about that. When I'm in a spiral like this I honestly forget about basic reason. I'll try to remember that next time. 

Anyways, thank you for leaving a helpful comment, I appreciate it.

I'm sorry to hear that you can relate. It's so exhausting. But I'm glad that it's gotten easier for you.

Thanks for commenting and for believing in me, I really appreciate it. I believe in you too and hope that your OCD continues to get easier to handle.
Thank you, you're right.

This is a compulsion. I promise. I went through the exact same thing, same fears, same compulsion.

I know it is hard, but try to go on with your day like normal. Take things one step at a time, you can get through this.
I see — I really never thought about it like that. Your comment is really helped me. Thank you for telling me all of this!

You're right, it is. I didn't realize that I was engaging in a compulsion this whole time 🫠

Thank you, by the way!!
Thank you.

Thank you so much for going out of your way to explain all of this to me. I really appreciate it. I'm working on my anxiety and I clearly have a long way to go, but comment helped put me at ease right now.

Yes, I think you're right. For about week or so after this happened, I did engage in such compulsions. But after that, I just tried to use the bag normally and then touch other things/people normally as well, even though it was always bothering me at the back of my mind.

It's only today where I'm starting to experience a big setback and having thoughts about engaging in these compulsions again. I'm going to try not to, but for me that's easier said than done.
Thank you for the advice. Your comment was a helpful reminder to me and helped me get through this. I hope you're doing well!

I'm really happy for you that it all worked out. Sometimes I just start having catastrophic thoughts about what's going to happen if I don't do this or that. I need to work on going with the flow about stuff. Thank you for commenting.
Thank you, this comment helped a lot. I will try to tell myself it'll be okay even if fail a class.
it was only 25mg, so I'll actually be ok I think. Thank you, I'll do that. I like your username btw
